Definition: honour; used (figuratively) for the capital city (Jerusalem)
BiblicalUsage: Heder means honour, glory, the splendour of a kingdom, and it appears once, in Daniel's portrait of a king who taxes his people to keep it. In Daniel 11:20 a raiser of taxes stands up in the glory of the kingdom, and within a few days he is destroyed, neither in anger nor in battle.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the verse is a small, cold biography of power: glory bought with taxes, and gone in a few days.
